body:
## Summary

Passes the in-cloud liquid specific humidity to the aerosol droplet-number closure in `update_cloud_properties!`, replaces the unbounded linear-in-log closure with a bounded log-saturation law, and zero-initializes `prescribed_aerosols_field` at cache construction.

### Closure and cache changes

- `update_cloud_properties!` passes the in-cloud liquid specific humidity `max(0, q_liq) / max(eps, cf)` [kg/kg] to `ml_N_cloud_liquid_droplets`, matching the units of the reference `q₀_liq`, and drops the column liquid-water-path integral.
- `ml_N_cloud_liquid_droplets` evaluates `s = Σ_i α_i log(max(c_i / c₀_i, 10⁻³)) + α_q log(max(q_l / q₀, 10⁻³))` and `N = N₀ exp(Δ_max tanh(s / Δ_max))` with `Δ_max = ln 3`, so `N ∈ [N₀ / 3, 3 N₀]` and `N ≈ N₀ (1 + s)` for small `|s|`. The bound and the floor are provisional (TODO note in the docstring).
- A species with no prescribed bins enters the closure at its reference concentration (`sum_aerosol_bins!`), so it leaves `N` unchanged. Before, it was floored at `10⁻³ c₀` and lowered `N` (to ~0.35 N₀ with no aerosols, for nonzero `α`).
- The liquid and ice effective radii are zero where the cloud fraction is zero, which changes the `reffclw` and `reffcli` diagnostics there. RRTMGP masks those cells, so fluxes are unaffected.
- `prescribed_aerosols_field` is zero-initialized. It is evaluated only in the RRTMGP radiation callback, so it stays zero with gray or no radiation, including in the 2M activation; the comment records this with a TODO.

With the default `α = 0`, `N = N₀` and the radiative fluxes are unchanged. Coefficients fitted to the linear closure need refitting.

Peeled from `ts/swcre-30pct` (`ac51a67ee`) onto `main`.
title: Use in-cloud liquid specific humidity and bounded log-saturation in aerosol droplet activation
